title: A power saving for square-difference-free sets
main_claim: There are absolute constants c>0 and C such that every square-difference-free A⊆[N] has |A| ≤ C N^{1-c}. The proof defines Y(N,A)=Z_P(Fourier lift of 1_A), where Z_P comes from a reflection-positive tuple law on a product of prime fields and satisfies (|A|/N)^d ≤ Y. It then proves the recurrence Y(N) ≤ (1-ρ)Y(N/M0^2) + ρΣ_B η_B Y(N/(M0 q_B)^2) + O(N^{-σ0}) and closes it by strong induction, giving Y ≪ N^{-a0}.
coverage:
I read all nine sections of the LaTeX source in full and checked each step:
- Section 2: the eigenvalue bound for the single-constraint kernel, the telescoping graph count, and the four-cycle trace bound with Σ C(4,t)t c^{4-t} = 4(1+c)^3.
- Section 3: no loops or opposite edges in the address graph; θ-symmetry of each component; the marked-cut lower bound (off-diagonal gaps ≥ g+1, diagonal dominance with κ, Schur-product PSD argument, E ⪰ λI); the unmarked-cut operator error; the list-regrouping domination I_+ ≤ I_{S'} with restriction probability r^{-n}; the exact pairing decomposition of M_p; the exceptional-mass exponent 81/16; conditional mixing via the leading component plus small nonleading mass; the pair marginals.
- Section 4: the folding Cauchy–Schwarz, the bubble-sort fold composition, the maximizer argument, seminorm properties, and conductor decay via the tensor operator and the orthogonality of the K_U.
- Section 5: the conditional square-sum large-sieve bound (Gram matrix, separation Q^{-2}), the square-function moment induction, decoupling, iterated Khintchine, and the specialization cost.
- Section 6: the sign conventions of the model-kernel centers, local root and 2-adic computations, the exact match c = c_0 for q1 ≤ H, the Gauss-sum bound for q1 > H, the Weyl/minor-arc exponents (each numeric exponent recomputed), and the bilinear Plancherel identity.
- Section 7: the exact fiber coefficients and the affine identity g_{≤H} = (λ/D)Σ_j h_j(T_j z), checked coefficient by coefficient; the projection to Y(N',A'_j); the error exponents.
- Section 8: existence of good residues, the ascending-edge argument, matching the remaining frequency set with the kernel's Ξ, the strict-square class mod D, and the exponent bookkeeping (23τ = 5888σ0, (3d+2)τ < 3β/64000).
- Section 9: the signed inclusion–exclusion, the bound Σ q_B η_B ≤ 1/4, θ ≤ √r, and the closing of the induction.
I verified the arithmetic by hand and did not run any scripts.
